parsed.name: small_cap_catalyst_book
parsed.strategy: Bet on a dense cluster of dated FDA PDUFA decisions landing inside Oct 12-Nov 13 plus the adjacent Nov-Dec dates, concentrated in small/mid-cap biotech where a single binary event moves the stock. Every name carries a primary-sourced catalyst date and most show positive 90-day analyst revision flow. I avoid the pre-PDUFA run-up names with the worst CRL-tail asymmetry by keeping weights at 3-9% and holding 16 names. I would be wrong if a broad risk-off tape or a cluster of CRLs hits the book at once, since these are highly correlated binary events.

strategy.brief: Small-cap catalyst: smaller but liquid names (band small/mid) with a dated catalyst; pay attention to cost_bps, you pay it. Competition rules: long only, global, <= 10% per name, >= 8 names, NO ETFs, cash <= 2%, graded as relative P&L vs the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13.
